items:
Reasons to Rent
• Magnificent beachfront 5-bedroom luxury home
• Located on one of the quietest, least crowded beaches on 30A
• Exclusive gated community with private beach patrol
• Community pool with Mediterranean-style design
• Seasonal beach service included March 1 – October 31
• Commercial ice maker, perfect for beach days and entertaining


Things to Know
• Parking limited to 4 large vehicles or 5 mid-size vehicles
• HOA strictly enforces noise limits and prohibits large gatherings
• No pets allowed (HOA rule)
• Non-smoking community (smoking allowed only at nearby public beach)
• Golf carts permitted in parking areas only
• No beach tents allowed
• Private community beach access located one house away
• Minimum rental age: 25
• Contactless arrival and departure
• Check-in: 4:00 PM | Check-out: 10:00 AM
• Pool hours: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM (heated during Spring Break, Thanksgiving week, and Christmas week per HOA)
• Maximum occupancy: 14 guests (strictly enforced)


From the moment you arrive, Done Inn makes an unforgettable impression. Guests enter through a striking foyer featuring a custom wave wall and convenient storage nook for beach gear.

The entry level includes a spacious bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds (four twins) plus a queen bed perfect for kids or additional guests. A half bathroom is located across the hall, along with a laundry room featuring a second refrigerator. This level also provides access to the garage, where bicycles are stored for guest use.


Once you ascend the stairs, you'll arrive on the main level and at the heart of the home, a massive, newly remodeled chef's kitchen designed to impress. This state-of-the-art space features:

• Premium stainless steel appliances
• Oversized refrigerator
• Six-burner gas range
• Stunning copper vent hood and backsplash
• Custom cabinetry
• Large bar seating for six
• Wet bar with wine fridge and prep sink

The open layout and warm woodwork create the perfect gathering space for family meals and celebrations.

Adjacent to the kitchen is a convenient half bath and a hallway leading to a main-floor king suite with flat-screen TV and a private ensuite bathroom featuring a large walk-in shower and double vanity.


Upstairs, the primary suite offers panoramic Gulf views, a king bed, cozy sitting area, dual closets, and access to a private terrace overlooking the water. The spa-like ensuite bathroom includes a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and double vanity.

Two additional bedrooms on this level provide comfort and privacy:

• Bedroom with two queen beds and ensuite bath (shower/tub combo)
• King bedroom with ensuite bath (shower/tub combo)

All bedrooms include flat-screen TVs.


Beach & Community Amenities
Vizcaya is one of 30A's most exclusive beachfront neighborhoods. Guests access the beach via a private walkway just one house away, leading down a staircase to an exceptionally quiet stretch of sand reserved for community guests and monitored by beach patrol.

Included with your stay:

• Two sets of seasonal beach service (March 1 – October 31)
• Beautiful Mediterranean-style community pool (heated in winter months per HOA)
• Poolside restroom, shower, and bar area


Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 14)
• Primary Suite: King bed, ensuite bath with tub and walk-in shower
• Third Floor East Bedroom: Two queen beds, ensuite bath
• Third Floor West Bedroom: King bed, ensuite bath
• Main Floor Bedroom: King bed, ensuite bath
• Bunk Room: Two twin-over-twin bunks (4 twins) + queen bed, nearby half bath


Done Inn offers the ultimate 30A experience with its luxurious space, quiet private beach, and a location close to everything. Whether you're biking to dinner, relaxing by the pool, or watching sunsets from your terrace, this extraordinary home promises a vacation filled with comfort, connection, and unforgettable coastal memories.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located on the beach, this vacation home is in Dune Allen Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Santa Rosa Beach and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Traveling with kids? Consider Sirens at the Beach and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze. Jet skiing, kayaking, and snorkeling offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking/biking trails nearby.

reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: We had a fabulous one week stay at Done Inn. The house and the location exceeded our expectations. The house was beautifully decorated, very clean and spacious… all contributing to make this our best beach vacation ever. The large kitchen provided everything that we could possibly need. The amazing porch overlooking the beach was our favorite gathering place. We plan to be back next year!!
reviews.title: Excellent stay at Done Inn

reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response: Thank you for your kind words! We're so glad the home had everything you needed and that you enjoyed the easy beach and pool access. It's wonderful to hear you felt safe and well taken care of during your stay. We'd love to welcome you back anytime!

reviews.text: Everything was wonderful. Everything we needed was there (grill, bikes, beach towels,stocked kitchen, bathroom amenities, etc.). Communication was easy as was getting in and out of house. This complex felt very safe and we saw the security guard on numerous occasions. There was easy access to the beach and pool. We loved everything about this place.
